entities.summary: Jack Henry López is a Puerto Rican professional baseball infielder for El Águila de Veracruz of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Boston Red Sox and Los Angeles Angels. Listed at 5 feet 10 inches (1.78 m) and 160 pounds (73 kg), he bats and throws right-handed.
